title: Prediction and validation of anoikis-related genes in neuropathic pain using machine learning.
authors: He, Yufeng; Wei, Ye; Wang, Yongxin; Ling, Chunyan; Qi, Xiang; Geng, Siyu; Meng, Yingtong; Deng, Hao; Zhang, Qisong; Qin, Xiaoling; Chen, Guanghui
one_liner_zh: 该研究用机器学习筛选神经病理性疼痛中失巢凋亡相关基因并做湿实验验证，仅涉及转录因子预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Neuropathic pain (NP) can be induced by a variety of clinical conditions, such as spinal cord injury, lumbar disc herniation (LDH), lumbar spinal stenosis, diabetes, herpes zoster, and spinal cord tumors, and inflammatory stimuli. The pathogenesis of NP is extremely complex. Specifically, in LDH, the herniated nucleus pulposus exerts mechanical pressure on nerve roots, triggering local inflammation and consequent NP. Anoikis, a special form of programmed cell death, is closely related to the progression of NP. In this study, we sought to clarify the molecular characteristics of anoikis-related genes in NP, providing novel insights for the diagnosis and treatment of NP. METHODS: We screened NP-related genes based on the GSE124272 dataset and obtained 439 anoikis-related genes from the GeneCards database. Through Least Absolute Shrinkage and Selection Operator (LASSO) and Support Vector Machine (SVM) machine learning algorithms, six key hub genes were identified: hepatocyte growth factor (HGF), matrix metalloproteinase 13 (MMP13), c-abl oncogene 1, non-receptor tyrosine kinase (ABL1), elastase neutrophil expressed (ELANE), fatty acid synthase (FASN), and long non-coding RNA (Linc00324). Functional enrichment analyses, including Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), alongside Gene Set Enrichment Analysis (GSEA) and immune infiltration analysis, were performed on these hub genes. Additionally, transcription factors and potential therapeutic drugs were predicted. We also used rats to construct an NP model and validated the analyzed hub genes using hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) staining, real-time polymerase chain reaction (PCR), and Western blotting assays. RESULTS: Our data indicated that anoikis-related genes have diagnostic value in NP patients, as confirmed by experimental results. Moreover, this study elucidated the role of these genes in immune infiltration during the pathogenesis of NP and identified potential therapeutic drugs targeting these key genes. CONCLUSION: This study further explores the pathogenesis of NP and provides certain reference value for developing targeted therapeutic strategies, thereby improving NP management.
abstract_zh: 背景：神经病理性疼痛（NP）可由多种临床状况诱发，如脊髓损伤、腰椎间盘突出症（LDH）、腰椎管狭窄、糖尿病、带状疱疹、脊髓肿瘤及炎症刺激。NP的发病机制极为复杂。具体而言，在LDH中，突出的髓核对神经根施加机械压力，触发局部炎症并继而导致NP。失巢凋亡（anoikis）作为一种特殊形式的程序性细胞死亡，与NP的进展密切相关。本研究旨在阐明NP中失巢凋亡相关基因的分子特征，为NP的诊断和治疗提供新见解。方法：基于GSE124272数据集筛选NP相关基因，并从GeneCards数据库获取439个失巢凋亡相关基因。通过最小绝对收缩和选择算子（LASSO）及支持向量机（SVM）机器学习算法，鉴定出六个关键枢纽基因：肝细胞生长因子（HGF）、基质金属蛋白酶13（MMP13）、c-abl癌基因1非受体酪氨酸激酶（ABL1）、中性粒细胞弹性蛋白酶（ELANE）、脂肪酸合酶（FASN）及长链非编码RNA（Linc00324）。对这些枢纽基因进行了功能富集分析，包括基因本体论（GO）和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG），以及基因集富集分析（GSEA）和免疫浸润分析。此外，预测了转录因子和潜在治疗药物。我们还使用大鼠构建NP模型，并通过苏木精-伊红（H&E）染色、实时聚合酶链反应（PCR）和Western blotting实验验证了所分析的枢纽基因。结果：我们的数据表明，失巢凋亡相关基因在NP患者中具有诊断价值，这一结论已通过实验结果得到证实。此外，本研究阐明了这些基因在NP发病过程中免疫浸润中的作用，并识别了针对这些关键基因的潜在治疗药物。结论：本研究进一步探讨了NP的发病机制，并为制定靶向治疗策略提供了一定的参考价值，从而改善NP的管理。
